slot_scores.name: ending_backorders_zero
slot_scores.rationale: The agent's questions covered the ending inventory constraint (turn 1), the overtime limit interpretation (turn 2), and whether the workforce could change (turn 3), but never asked about a terminal condition requiring backorders to be zero or all demand to be met by the end of the horizon.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The conversation ended abruptly with repeated truncated/incomplete questions (turns 4-30) and never reached a READY_TO_MODEL or equivalent final modeling state, leaving the P1 hidden slot H1 unresolved.

summary: The agent asked only three coherent questions before degenerating into repeated incomplete questions, never addressing the terminal backorder constraint and never reaching a final modeling state, so the interaction was unproductive.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
